parse_into_expression: parse a string, list, or Expr into a PyExpr expression with optional structify and dtype
parse_into_list_of_expressions: parse multiple positional and keyword inputs into a list of PyExpr expressions
parse_into_selector: parse a column name or Expr into a polars Selector with strict mode
parse_list_into_selector: parse a collection of column names or selectors into a combined polars Selector
parse_predicates_constraints_into_expres: parse predicates and constraints into a single AND-reduced PyExpr expression
